request.project_task: Create a restaurant table reservation service.
request.project_goal: Accept reservations while respecting table capacity.
request.project_description: A guest requests a table; staff can confirm, modify, or cancel reservations.

functional_requirements.text: A guest searches available times for party size and date.

atoms.text: A guest searches available times for party size and date.

functional_requirements.text: A guest submits contact details to reserve a table.

atoms.text: A guest submits contact details to reserve a table.

functional_requirements.text: The system prevents reservations above available capacity.

atoms.text: The system prevents reservations above available capacity.

functional_requirements.text: Staff can modify an existing reservation.

atoms.text: Staff can modify an existing reservation.

functional_requirements.text: Staff can cancel an existing reservation.

atoms.text: Staff can cancel an existing reservation.

non_functional_requirements.text: Contact details must not be displayed to unauthorized staff roles.

actors.name: Guest
actors.description: A person who wants to reserve a table at the restaurant.

use_cases.name: Search Available Times
use_cases.goal: Find available reservation times for a given party size and date.
use_cases.trigger: Guest wants to reserve a table and needs to see available times.

preconditions.text: The guest has access to the reservation system.

success_postconditions.text: The guest is presented with a list of available times for the requested party size and date.

failure_postconditions.text: The guest is informed that no available times exist for the requested party size and date.

steps.action: Guest enters party size and date.

steps.expected_result: System checks table availability against capacity.
Guest sees a list of available times.

steps.action: Guest enters party size and date.

steps.expected_result: System checks table availability against capacity.
System informs guest that no times are available.

user_stories.capability: search for available reservation times by party size and date
user_stories.benefit: I can find a suitable time to reserve a table.

system_stories.system_action: Check table availability against capacity for the requested party size and date.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure that only times with sufficient capacity are shown.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Search Available Times
Goal: Find available reservation times for a given party size and date.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Guest wants to reserve a table and needs to see available times.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: The guest has access to the reservation system.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Guest enters party size and date.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] Guest requests available times.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] System displays available times.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-EXC-001: No available times
Source FRs: FR-001, FR-003

use_cases.name: Submit Reservation
use_cases.goal: Reserve a table by providing contact details.
use_cases.trigger: Guest selects an available time and proceeds to reserve.

preconditions.text: The guest has selected an available time from the search results.

success_postconditions.text: The reservation is created and confirmed.

failure_postconditions.text: The reservation is not created due to capacity or invalid details.

steps.expected_result: System checks capacity and creates the reservation.
System detects that capacity is exceeded.
Guest is informed that the reservation cannot be made due to capacity.

user_stories.capability: submit my contact details to reserve a table
user_stories.benefit: I can secure a table for my desired time.

system_stories.system_action: Validate contact details and check capacity before creating reservation.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure reservation is only created if capacity is available and details are valid.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Submit Reservation
Goal: Reserve a table by providing contact details.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Guest selects an available time and proceeds to reserve.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: The guest has selected an available time from the search results.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Guest selects an available time.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] Guest enters contact details.
  3. [STEP-UC002-003] Guest submits the reservation.
  4. [STEP-UC002-004] System confirms the reservation.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-EXC-001: Capacity exceeded
Source FRs: FR-002, FR-003

use_cases.name: Modify Reservation
use_cases.trigger: Staff needs to change details of an existing reservation.

success_postconditions.text: The reservation is updated with new details.

failure_postconditions.text: The reservation is not modified due to capacity or invalid details.

steps.expected_result: System checks capacity and updates the reservation.
System detects that capacity is exceeded.
Staff is informed that the modification cannot be made due to capacity.

user_stories.benefit: I can accommodate changes requested by guests.

system_stories.system_action: Validate new details and check capacity before updating reservation.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure reservation is only modified if capacity is available and details are valid.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — Modify Reservation
Goal: Modify an existing reservation.
Primary actor: ACT-002
Trigger: Staff needs to change details of an existing reservation.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: An existing reservation exists.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] Staff selects an existing reservation.
  2. [STEP-UC003-002] Staff enters new details.
  3. [STEP-UC003-003] Staff submits the modification.
  4. [STEP-UC003-004] System confirms the modification.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC003-EXC-001: Capacity exceeded on modification
Source FRs: FR-004, FR-003

use_cases.name: Cancel Reservation
use_cases.trigger: Staff needs to cancel an existing reservation.

steps.expected_result: Staff sees that the reservation is cancelled.

user_stories.benefit: I can free up tables for other guests.

system_stories.system_action: Cancel the reservation upon staff confirmation.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure reservation is cancelled and capacity is updated.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-004 — Cancel Reservation
Goal: Cancel an existing reservation.
Primary actor: ACT-002
Trigger: Staff needs to cancel an existing reservation.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC004-001: An existing reservation exists.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC004-001] Staff selects an existing reservation.
  2. [STEP-UC004-002] Staff requests cancellation.
  3. [STEP-UC004-003] Staff confirms cancellation.
  4. [STEP-UC004-004] System confirms cancellation.
Source FRs: FR-005

issues.message: Step STEP-UC002-001 references FRs outside UC-002: FR-001
Step STEP-UC002-005 references FRs outside UC-002: FR-001

In UC-001, UC-002, and UC-003, several steps list the actor as the Guest or Staff but the action text describes the system performing the action (e.g., STEP-UC001-003 'System displays available times', STEP-UC002-004 'System confirms the reservation', STEP-UC003-004 'System confirms the modification'). This is a modeling inconsistency, not a violation of any FR.

UC-002 and UC-003 include validation of contact details and new details (e.g., STEP-UC002-002, STEP-UC003-002) that is not explicitly required by FR-002 or FR-004. This is an optional elaboration and does not contradict the FRs.
